risks: Short local page_ IDs/slug lookups differ from canonical kind:id refs; importing by title/path or silently generating second Page identity breaks aliases and sharing.
Core PageKind controls sandbox; overloading it with collaborative_document can accidentally enable scripts or force document through HTML lease/contentDigest prerequisites.
PageConfigSchema and broad UpdatePagePatch must be changed together; adding new managed fields without runtime protection permits metadata patch to alter representation/authority/schema.
Tiptap Markdown round-trip is not CRDT tree convergence; focused external-content suppression and default history are incompatible with a naive remote setContent/undo adapter.
WP-49 fallback may require production React Lexical adapter allocation beyond normative WP-10 file list; do not mark spike code as production implementation or invent ownership.
Workspace-wide LoadedPage pushes can leak title/body metadata even if document update authorization is correct; audience filtering and stale refresh/account-switch cancellation matter.
Digest-bound HTML action lease/grant and Cloudflare publication capability are distinct from resource ACL/sync policy lease; conflating them makes revoke acceptance false.
Independent sync workers with a separate authority/WAL or ACK-before-commit create post-revoke/lost-edit races. Enforce same Postgres document lock, shard fence and <=5s lease bound.
Snapshot materialization, search watermarks and client WAL pruning require exact frontier evidence; an advanced projection timestamp or failed snapshot is not a recoverable committed update.

Full service-registration gate includes attention/activity/agents/MCP/provenance although not all have direct WP-10 predecessor edges. Lead must allocate integrations without weakening completeness or creating circular dependencies.

COLLAB-01 includes selective undo/redo, A2 identity, retained private drafts, quota/corrupt snapshot/expired edits and dropped-event failures beyond the six headline bullets; these cannot be silently omitted.
Additional sync API DTOs, selected migrator, runtime topology and exact dependency licensing remain implementation prerequisites; their existence/readiness is not inferred from published plans.
Root-owned wave0 integration may invalidate these working-tree hashes. Report acceptance must be rejected or refreshed by actual re-inspection, not by updating hashes alone.
No product behavior was run in preflight; report/schema/hash verification cannot promote WP-10 to implemented, verified or featureComplete.
